description: Install locally available keys to authorise logins on a remote machine.

option.name: -f
tip: Forced mode: do not check whether the keys are already on the remote host.
This does not need the private key but may install the key more than once.

option.name: -F
tip: Specify an alternative ssh configuration file, passed through to ssh.

option.name: -i
tip: Use only the key or keys in the given file instead of the keys from ssh-agent or the default key.
The .pub suffix is added when missing; without a value the most recent ~/.ssh/id*.pub is used.

option.name: -n
tip: Dry run: print the keys that would be installed instead of installing them.

option.name: -o
tip: Pass an option through to ssh or sftp in the ssh_config(5) format.

option.name: -p
tip: Set the port to connect to on the remote host.

option.name: -s
tip: Use sftp mode instead of executing commands on the remote side.
Useful when the server restricts remote commands.

option.name: -t
tip: Set the path on the target system where keys are added.

option.name: -x
tip: Enable shell tracing to debug the script itself.
